#include <iostream>

using namespace std;

class HZSShufflesCards {
public:
    long long mod = 998244353;
    int n;
    int m;

    void solve(int testNumber, InputReader& in, ostream& out) {
        n = in.nextInt();
        m = in.nextInt();

        long long inv = modInverse(n + m);
        long long phaseSize = 1;
        long long p = 1;
        for (int i = 0; p != 0; i++) {
            p = (p * (n - i)) % mod * modInverse(n + m - i) % mod;
            phaseSize = (phaseSize + p) % mod;
        }

        long long answer = 0;
        for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
            long long numPhases = (m + k) * modInverse(k) % mod;
            long long e = (numPhases * phaseSize) % mod;
            long long term = (ncr(n, k) * e) % mod;

            if (k % 2 == 1)
                answer = (answer + term) % mod;
            else
                answer = (answer - term + mod) % mod;
        }

        out << answer << endl;
    }

private:
    long long modInverse(long long a) {
        long long b = mod;
        long long x = 0, y = 1;

        while (b != 0) {
            long long q = a / b;
            a -= q * b;
            swap(a, b);
            x -= q * y;
            swap(x, y);
        }

        if (x < 0)
            x += mod;

        return x;
    }

    long long ncr(int n, int r) {
        if (r < 0 || n < r)
            return 0;
        long long numerator = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
            numerator = (numerator * i) % mod;
        long long denominator = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= r; i++)
            denominator = (denominator * i) % mod;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n - r; i++)
            denominator = (denominator * i) % mod;
        return (numerator * modInverse(denominator)) % mod;
    }
};

class InputReader {
public:
    string next() {
        string str;
        while (!str.empty()) {
            cin >> str;
            if (cin.fail()) {
                cin.clear();
                cin.ignore(10000, '\n');
            }
        }
        return str;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        string str = next();
        return stoi(str);
    }
};

    return 0;
}
